assets.scope: Standee batch 3 (13 ids). Second artwork used only for the upright standee layer at <=48px cells. Identity evidence: the shipped native sprite and the shipped flat token, both pinned below; the game was not launched for this round. Flat 128px token, its master and the manifest mapping are untouched. Reused dragon-family composition: rearing on the hind legs with the chest lifted, the wings folded tight or held in a narrow vertical V, never spread wide, and the tail curled close; the on-screen body height may land around 1.2-1.75 cells because of the 1.0-cell width cap, which is accepted.
assets.gate_reason: The shipped flat 128px cut-out is a near-square top-down token; at the 1.0-cell standee width cap it is width-bound and renders about one cell tall, reading as the flat token rather than an upright standee. A full-body upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.
assets.desc: An old and powerful multi-hued drake, armed with many deadly breath weapons and nasty claws.

references.note: The shipped flat greater multi-hued wyrm token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours, value structure and identity. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native greater multi-hued wyrm sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, colour pattern and markings, converted to a true upright composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.
The storm wyrm in this family is the sibling dragon this one must stay clearly distinct from: it raises its head high looking up with a fan crest and both wings lifted in a narrow vertical V.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: greater multi-hued wyrm: a huge ancient multi-hued dragon REARING on its hind legs in an ASYMMETRIC twisted stance, most of the weight on one leg while the other is drawn up, the torso twisted and the head TURNED BACK OVER THE SHOULDER to look behind; armoured plates shaded across a rainbow range (violet, blue, teal, emerald, gold, magenta) over a pale cream ribbed belly, a small head crowned by a backswept crest, LAYERED folded wings overlapping tight along the flanks, and the tail curled close. Match the shipped flat token's multi-coloured plate range and cream belly.
prompt_fields.contrast: The twist is the signature: the body leans onto one leg, the shoulders and head TURN BACK over the raised shoulder, so the silhouette is an off-axis S rather than a symmetric upright, with the layered wings and tail kept inside the outline and nothing spread. It differs from every other dragon by this turned-back asymmetric pose and by the many-hued plates. No breath, mist or particles.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, REARING three-quarter view in an asymmetric twisted stance on one leg, chest lifted and the head turned back over the shoulder, layered wings folded along the flanks, tail curled close. Overall height about 1.4 to 1.7 times the width; the crest is body, nothing else above the head.
prompt_fields.palette: many-hued armoured plates from violet and indigo through teal and emerald to gold and magenta, unified by one warm light, pale cream ribbed belly, dull bone crest and claws.
